column1: # PLANK WITHDRAWAL ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS — read by tools/plank_status.py
# A commit subject can carry a retirement word without retiring the plank
# Prose cannot settle that, so plank_status flags it SUSPECT and stops flagging
# once the answer is recorded HERE, as a decision someone typed.
# Adding a row is a decision on the record. A `DEAD` row makes the tool refuse
# that plank outright; a `NOT-A-WITHDRAWAL` row silences it for that commit ONLY
# — a later retirement commit flags again, which is the whole point.
